properties.name: Enemy body or head launched after kill
properties.check: After a killing blow, is the enemy's body or severed head catapulted unnaturally into the sky or flung with extreme ragdoll force far beyond what the attack would realistically cause?

properties.name: Character floating in air
properties.check: Is a character hovering in mid-air in a seated, standing, or falling pose but their position is not actually changing? They appear stuck or suspended with no ground contact and no downward movement.

properties.name: Horse or animal slides without leg animation
properties.check: Is a horse or animal gliding across the ground sideways or forward with completely static legs — no walking, trotting, or running animation playing while the model moves?

properties.name: Monster frozen or twitching in place
properties.check: Is a monster or creature completely frozen in its idle pose while the player moves freely, or is it twitching, jerking, and sliding without playing a proper movement or attack animation?

properties.name: Character clips through closed door or wall
properties.check: Does a character walk straight through a closed door or solid wall without opening it or breaking it? Their body passes through the barrier as if it does not exist.

properties.name: Missing body part or T-pose
properties.check: Is an NPC's head or body part completely invisible or not rendered, or is an NPC frozen in a T-pose (arms straight out, legs apart) instead of their normal idle animation?

properties.name: Boat flips or spins uncontrollably
properties.check: Does a small boat suddenly flip upside down or spin rapidly in calm water without impact?

properties.name: NPC walks without moving legs
properties.check: Is an NPC visibly moving forward while their legs remain completely still in idle stance?

properties.name: Enemy stuck half underground
properties.check: Is a monster or enemy partially submerged in the ground, with legs or torso visibly inside terrain while still alive or attacking?

properties.name: Dead body bends unnaturally
properties.check: After death, does an enemy's body twist into an impossible shape with limbs sharply bent backward or stretched unnaturally?
